University of Melbourne, SAF Music Provident Fund 2025 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia for students enrolled in the Bachelor of Music Jazz and Improvisation or Bachelor of Music Interactive Composition at the university. The fund aims to support loans and grants for purposes associated with their music studies. The selected students will receive a one-time scholarship up to AUD 250 (₹13,627).
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be an Australian/domestic or an International student
be enrolled in the University of Melbourne Conservatorium of Music in either the Jazz and Improvisation or Interactive Composition disciplines

Questions: Who is eligible to join the SAF Music Provident Fund?

Eligibility for the SAF Music Provident Fund is generally open to individuals actively involved in the South African music industry. This may include musicians, composers, producers, and other industry professionals.
Questions: What is the SAF Music Provident Fund scholarship?
The SAF Music Provident Fund scholarship is a financial aid opportunity offered at the University of Melbourne to support students pursuing specific music degrees.
Questions: How many times can I receive this scholarship?
Students can only receive this particular SAF Music Provident Fund scholarship once during their degree.
Questions: When is the application deadline?
The last date to apply for this scheme is 30 March 2025
Questions: What can the scholarship funds be used for?
The scholarship is intended to assist with expenses related to the student's music studies.
